'''Trace Polters''' was the owner and operator of [[Ma'Haffee Shipyard]]s in the [[Cularin system/Legends|Cularin]] [[Star system/Legends|star system]]. He allied himself with the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Almas Academy|satellite academy]] on [[Almas]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. Prior to that, he assisted the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] by providing them with [[Starship/Legends|starships]]. [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] Polters became incredibly wealthy when he sold Ma'Haffee Shipyards to the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].
